weekSummary: Hearty winter meals built around chicken thighs on special and a slow pork stew to warm up the cooler nights

meals.name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
meals.description: Fragrant green curry with chicken thighs, zucchini and coconut cream over jasmine rice
method: Cut chicken into large chunks. Slice zucchini into half-moons.
Heat oil in a large pan. Fry curry paste 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and cook 3 minutes until sealed on all sides.
Pour in coconut cream and fish sauce. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Add zucchini and cook 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Cook rice separately. Taste curry and adjust fish sauce and lime juice.
Serve over rice with fresh coriander if available.

meals.name: Slow Pork Shoulder and Bean Stew
meals.description: Melt-in-the-mouth pork shoulder braised with white beans, rosemary and tomato
method: Cut pork shoulder into large chunks, about 5cm. Season generously.
Brown in batches in a heavy pot until deeply caramelised on all sides. Set aside.
Soften onion and garlic in the same pot 8 minutes.
Return pork, add tomatoes, stock and rosemary. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low heat 1.5 hours until pork is very tender.
Add drained white beans, simmer uncovered 20 minutes until sauce thickens.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

meals.name: Chicken Thigh Traybake with Kumara
meals.description: One-pan roasted chicken thighs with kumara, red onion and a lemon-herb dressing
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cut kumara and red onion into wedges.
Toss vegetables with olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper. Spread on a large tray.
Rub chicken thighs with olive oil, salt, pepper and lemon zest. Place on top of vegetables.
Roast 45 minutes until chicken skin is crispy and vegetables are caramelised.
Squeeze lemon juice over everything and rest 5 minutes before serving.

meals.name: Beef and Broccoli with Rice
meals.description: Tender beef strips and broccoli in a glossy oyster sauce, served over steamed rice
method: Toss beef strips in cornflour, soy sauce and a little baking soda. Marinate 15 minutes.
Cook rice according to packet.
Blanch broccoli florets in boiling water 2 minutes. Drain.
Heat wok until smoking. Stir fry beef in batches — don't crowd the pan.
Return all beef, add broccoli and oyster sauce with a splash of water.
Toss on high heat 1 minute until sauce is glossy. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Butter Chicken with Naan
meals.description: Rich and creamy butter chicken sauce with chicken thighs, served with store-bought naan
method: Cut chicken into chunks. Coat in 2 tbsp butter chicken paste.
Cook chicken in butter over medium-high heat until golden. Remove.
Add remaining paste to pan, cook 1 minute. Add canned tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend sauce until smooth (optional). Return chicken to pan.
Stir in cream and simmer 10 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Warm naan in oven. Serve chicken over rice with naan for scooping.
